title: SourceUnitValue
description: Reference aggregate value template for the SourceUnit panel: symbol-level interpretations inside a single language/format unit. Pack-owned. Examples used by the Repository Sourcing Pack: CodeUnit (carries SCIP SymbolInformation), JpaEntity, ProtoMessage, GraphqlSchema, IacResource. Operational form: the Pack declares per-slot value schemas in `pack-manifest.panels[].slots`; this file documents the shared envelope.

sourceIdentityKey.description: Stable per-source identity for this unit (e.g. fully-qualified symbol).
